'''Lekern Renald''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he served as a [[Station chief/Legends|station chief]] in [[Sobrik]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where he assisted [[Cipher Nine]] during the [[Operation: Blackout]]. Renald put Cipher in contact with [[Sanju Pyne]], which allowed the agent to infiltrate the [[Balmorran resistance]] and get close to their ultimate target - the [[Gray Star]].
